name: low-mood-kind-good
description: Probe (f): handled kindly and patiently with the right outcome: same-day duty clinician call and NHS 111 press 2.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi... um, is that the doctors? I just need to see someone.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Good morning, Pen-y-Bryn Surgery, Sam speaking. Don't worry, take your time. Can I take your name?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thank you Rhys. Is it you who'd like to be seen?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: That's fine, you don't have to tell me anything you don't want to. I'd just like to make sure we get you the right help. How have you been feeling lately?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I don't know. Not great. Low, I suppose.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thank you for telling me. That sounds really hard. How long have you felt like this?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: A few weeks. I am not really sleeping either.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: I'm sorry, that must be exhausting. Rhys, I want to ask you something kindly. Have things got so bad that you've had any dark thoughts, or thoughts of harming yourself?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Sometimes I think people would be better off without me.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thank you for trusting me with that. I'm taking it seriously, and I don't want you to wait. I'm going to ask the duty clinician to phone you today. You can also ring NHS 111 and press 2 any time, for urgent mental health support.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Yes, today. If you feel worse or unsafe at any point, please call 111 and press 2, or 999, or ring us straight back. Is this the best number to reach you on?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yeah. Thanks for being nice about it.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: You're very welcome, Rhys. Take care.

expect.flagsReason: Same-day contact with the duty clinician plus 111 press 2 is the key's outcome; the red flag was drawn out and acted on.

greeting.reason: Own name, practice, caller name, whether for him.

information.reason: Unlocked low mood, sleep and the thoughts.

role.reason: No diagnosis; "sounds really hard" is empathy not diagnosis.

explanation.reason: Where (clinician call today), why (taking it seriously) and what to do if worse.

manner.reason: Patient, kind, gave him control and did not push.
